start: A rest running; watch app notifications allowed; the app open on the rest timer

user_sees: The round screen filled with the gym's colour: "Rest is over" and "−0:00" counting up
must_not: No buzz while the phone is in use

user_sees: Card "Rest is over" with "Next: Set 3 of 5 · Bench Press" (or "Time for your next set"); no button on it
must_not: A "Complete set" button that the code no longer has (the feature's name still says it)
The card staying for the rest of the day

start: "Ring through Do Not Disturb" on in the phone app; the watch in Do Not Disturb

user_sees: The buzz gets through Do Not Disturb
must_not: Silence while the switch is on

steps.action: Turn the switch off on the phone; next rest ends
user_sees: No buzz while Do Not Disturb is on
must_not: A buzz through Do Not Disturb with the switch off

user_sees: The app screen shows "Rest is over"; no card

steps.action: Log the set on the phone
user_sees: The screen moves to the next set
must_not: "Rest is over" staying after the set was logged

user_sees: The old "Rest is over" card goes
must_not: Two cards on the watch face
The card staying 2 minutes after the workout ended
